Title: Attempt to create a shop with a non-admin user role
Preconditions: User is logged in with a role other than ADMIN (e.g., CUSTOMER or SHOP_WORKER)
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Create Shop' form. 2. Fill in all required fields with valid data (shop name, phone, address, geo-location, owner name, username, email, area ID). 3. Submit the form.

Test Data: Shop Name: Test Shop, Shop Phone: 1234567890, Address: 123 Test St, Geo-Location: 12.34,56.78, Owner Name: Test Owner, Username: testowner, Email: testowner@example.com, Area ID: 1
Expected Result: The system should reject the request and display an error message indicating that only users with the ADMIN role can create shops.

Title: Attempt to update a shop with a non-admin and non-owner user role
Preconditions: User is logged in with a role other than ADMIN or SHOP_OWNER (e.g., CUSTOMER or SHOP_WORKER), and a shop exists in the system
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Edit Shop' form for an existing shop. 2. Modify one or more fields (e.g., shop name, phone). 3. Submit the form.

Test Data: Shop ID: 1, Shop Name: Updated Test Shop, Shop Phone: 9876543210
Expected Result: The system should reject the request and display an error message indicating that the user does not have permission to update this shop.
